name: Mark Thompson
story: Mark Thompson, GIS business leader at Tauranga City Council, organised a Bay of Plenty GIS gathering in May 2009. On 8 September 2010 he circulated a crowd-sourced Christchurch earthquake map through GISList. His correspondence records council practitioners organising local technical exchange and sharing public mapping during an emergency.
